investigation_record.reasoning_summary: The transaction triggered a high-risk ML score of 0.87, but the graph neighborhood analysis reveals no multi-hop linked cards and only a single shared device count, failing to meet the threshold for Typology B (Distributed Device Ring) which requires at least 3 distinct accounts. No evidence of impossible travel or geo-velocity anomalies was provided to trigger Typology E. Historical precedents (CC-0657, CC-0634, CC-1058) with similar risk scores and transaction amounts were cleared as benign after customer confirmation, suggesting this is likely a false positive or a legitimate unusual purchase.

fired_signals.evidence: Real-time scoring model flagged transaction at 0.87 risk score.

retrieved_policies.title: Typology E: Geo-Velocity & Impossible Travel Anomaly (GEO-05)

actions_pre_evidence.justification: Moderate risk requires out-of-band verification challenge.

actions_post_evidence.justification: Initiate step-up verification to confirm cardholder identity given the high ML risk score, consistent with handling high-score alerts that lack definitive fraud evidence.
Notify the customer of the flagged transaction to allow for immediate confirmation or dispute, aligning with historical precedents where customer confirmation cleared similar alerts.
